facts.fact: Statutory Instrument No. 86 of 2021, made 24 September 2021 by the Minister for Presidential Affairs, Governance and Public Administration, brought the Data Protection Act (Act No. 32 of 2018) into operation on the date of the Order's publication, 15 October 2021.

systems.owner: Ministry for Presidential Affairs, Governance and Public Administration (Minister holds the commencement power)

systems.system: Data Protection Act (Commencement Date) Order, 2021 (S.I. No. 86 of 2021)
systems.owner: Minister for Presidential Affairs, Governance and Public Administration

note: The document states commencement only; it says nothing on the authority, application or the last twelve months. The commencement order is class regulation, so it gives no fact.
